correctness.rationale: Exact reflection parity reduction, disk rescaling, Gram-Schur complement with vanishing first diagonal perturbation, and capacity squeeze prove all quantifiers. value.rationale: These canonical finite-n bounds are computationally natural lower approximations to capacity. Their loss of monotonicity and sharp separation into asymptotically saturating even indices versus vanishing odd indices for every fixed degree characterize a meaningful structural failure of uniform degree-wise approximation.
